kind: ephemeral original metadata-upload inventory observation; no new persisted schema
original_binding: complete original plan/context/operation/allowances, exact source-bound metadata-upload digest and independently retained list payload; exact current pending mutation and observation IDs plus original reservation digest
methods: metadata allocation only; list_canister_snapshots only, same exact selected target; status/data-upload recovery unsupported
decoder: reuse original finite-work snapshot inventory admission, required nat64 timestamp/size, unique exact raw IDs, canonical view and exact raw-evidence hash
invocation: one previously accounted exact host replicated list update; no hidden retry, upload, query/proxy substitution or extra observation
integration_admission: retained originals, actual fresh read permission/context, authentication, chronology, original baseline custody, exclusive command custody and proof observation never dispatched; allocation attribution independently qualified
association: recheck current journal, actual authority/attempt/request/context/target claims then bounded wire shape; pure and passive, no IO or state transition
cardinality: zero, one or many snapshots, timestamps and sizes establish no allocation outcome or exclusive original-request attribution
failure_and_replay: lost reply and every provider failure retain pending mutation/observation spending, originals, references and obligations; local reconstruction/reopen grants no redispatch, refund or automatic Uncertain receipt
qualification: native structural admission, interface refusal and actual local persistence/reopen only; no simulated management behavior, installed provider or live/backend effects
grants: no default provider, automatic outcome, complete upload, load/start safety, terminal proof or fence/reference release
unchanged: existing exhaustive errors, v1 records/digests/bounds, journal spending owner, normal dependencies, package version and release receipt
async_contract: Await the provider with its currently guarded original journal; retain caller-owned exclusion across submission. Recheck original pending mutation/observation and exact reserved payload. Cancellation retains both attempts and grants no repeat call. No runtime or Send bound.
configured_adapter: AgentObservationProvider requires exact reserved-request and durable signed-envelope/request-ID retention under both original attempt identities and exclusive never-dispatched custody before one submission. No default retainer, current permission or automatic receipt.
